issue: RigidBodyDesc used the runtime body's translation API
resolution: Used Rapier 0.19.3 enabledTranslations on the descriptor

issue: Rink markings sampled a clamped corner of the texture
Idle connected gamepads masked keyboard input
foundBy: Input path review and regression checks
resolution: Only use pad values when the pad is the active input

issue: Closing a local-window guest did not notify the host
resolution: Added pagehide notification and heartbeat timeout; AI covers the shift

issue: Touch handling suppressed the pause button's native click
resolution: Only consume the context action buttons' touch events

issue: The SwiftShader WebGPU device was lost and left the rink blank
foundBy: WebGPU device state and visual inspection
resolution: Hardware adapters use WebGPU; known software adapters choose the WebGL2 backend before creating a device

issue: Gamepad action edges could be overwritten before a fixed physics tick
foundBy: Controller tests and review of polling at higher refresh rates
resolution: Latch shot/pass/check/switch events until the simulation consumes them
